threads.body: `tox` no longer runs the LangChain (and Weaviate) test environments in `envlist`. The LangChain package already has a non-empty `tests/` suite, so this effectively removes CI test coverage rather than fixing the underlying failure (e.g., missing test factors/requirements or missing runtime deps like `opentelemetry-util-genai`). Please restore the test envs and address the root cause so these tests keep running in CI.

     ; instrumentation-langchain
-    py3{10,11,12,13,14}-test-instrumentation-langchain
+    ; TODO: add tests/requirements.{oldest,latest}.txt and langchain-{oldest,latest}
+    ; factors below; declare opentelemetry-util-genai in the package pyproject.toml
+    ; (latent bug — code imports it but it's not in runtime deps).
     lint-instrumentation-langchain

threads.body: This workflow change removes the LangChain/Weaviate test jobs from CI. Since `instrumentation/opentelemetry-instrumentation-langchain/tests` contains an actual test suite, dropping these jobs will let regressions ship undetected. Please re-enable the LangChain test jobs (and fix the underlying install/dependency issue instead of skipping).

Please make the supported version shown here consistent with the package metadata (or adjust the metadata) to avoid misleading users and docs builds installing an incompatible version.
